name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, August 07, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Waronek
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-d, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special & Regular meetings held on July 17, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Consideration and Possible Approval of a Revised Professional Services Agreement with O'Neil Ventures, Inc.
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute the revised Professional Services Agreement with O'Neil Ventures, Inc.
Item #7d
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
APPOINTMENT OF A VOTING DELEGATE FOR THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES ANNUAL CONFERENCE, SEPTEMBER 12-14, 2018, IN LONG BEACH, CALIFORNIA
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: That the City Council appoint a voting delegate and an alternate for the League of California Cities Annual Conference business meeting to be held September 12-14, 2018, in Long Beach, CA.
Item #8
9.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION REGARDING THE 2018 STATE OF THE CITY EVENT
Presented by Parks & Recreation Director Harding
ACTION: That the City Council discuss plans for the 2018 State of the City event and provide direction.
Item #9
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
10.
CONSIDERATION OF SITE PLAN NO. 1192 AND VESTING TENTATIVE PARCEL TRACT MAP NO. 082091 FOR A PROPOSED SEVEN UNIT MULTI-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL PROJECT LOCATED AT 26012-26016 NARBONNE AVENUE IN THE RESIDENTIAL VARIABLE DENSITY (RVD-1500) ZONE
Presented by Assistant Planner MacMorran
Res 2018-28 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Site Plan Review No. 1192 for the development of seven new residential units with maximum height of 27 feet on a 19,150-square foot lot, located at 26012-26016 Narbonne Avenue in the Residential Variable Density 1500 (RVD-1500) Zone. (Filed by Ben Cauthen of Cauthen Design, Inc., 25332 Narbonne Avenue, Suite 100, Lomita, CA)
Res 2018-29 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Vesting Tentative Tract Map No. 082091 for the development of seven new residential units with a maximum height of 27 feet on a 19,150-square foot lot, located at 26012-26016 Narbonne Avenue in the Residential Variable Density 1500 (RVD-1500) Zone. (Filed by Ben Cauthen of Cauthen Design, Inc., 25332 Narbonne Avenue, Suite 100, Lomita, CA)
Item #10
11.
CONSIDERATION OF LOMITA ALEHOUSE SPECIAL PERMIT - 24123 NARBONNE AVENUE
Presented by Community and Economic Development Director Velasco
Res 2018-30 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Special Permits for coin-operated games of skill (Video Games), Pool and Billiard tables, and an entertainment license for live music and dancing for Lomita Alehouse located at 24123 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
ACTION: That after the hearing is conducted the City Council adopt the attached resolution approving Lomita Alehouse's Special Permits with conditions.
Item #11
12.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the next regular meeting to be held on Tuesday, August 21, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City's website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
